images.anchor: Billy stood back while the bank manager and police went in.
images.alt: Billy’s notebook and map help police identify the relocated laboratory, where the bank manager finds the open freestanding vault and its remaining bundles of money.

Jenny/Pink Blur same age, natural GREEN eyes, long curly golden BLONDE hair, WHITE domino mask, fitted PINK suit continuous WHITE side stripes, WHITE belt/gloves/boots. Billy is SHORT STOCKY OLDER ADULT like Dork in age, lined face, gray sideburns/eyebrows, tan trench coat high collar, red/brown plaid deerstalker, dark trousers BLACK shoes; never a child. Dork is older wild gray-white hair, huge round black spectacles, gray rolled-sleeve shirt dark trousers. Fist is ONE elongated independent red leather boxing glove, dimensional face and ROUND RED button nose, ONE tucked TOP/BACK thumbfold like quiff, no protruding underside/second thumb, no arm/body; SHORT RED cuff ONE inset WHITE rectangle thin BLACK keyline RED margins ALL FOUR edges, black narrow hollow rim. Jaws is one bodyless floating blond spiky-haired human HEAD with riveted metal jaw and triangular teeth, NO neck/torso/limbs. Laura is adult BROWN eyes, curly brown hair PONYTAIL, black domino mask, opaque BLACK full suit with flame-colored fabric side panels, BLACK gloves/boots, COAT OFF, wet from hydrant; no actual body flames. Flaming Head is ABSENT. SCENE: Late-afternoon INSIDE relocated old brick laboratory workshop. Main foreground Billy, short STOCKY OLDER detective with gray hair/sideburns wrinkled face (like reference1), stands left pointing OPEN NOTEBOOK and folded street map toward police. Center-right freestanding full-sized steel BANK VAULT on transport frame, door swung OPEN LEFT with scorched hole near wheel/locking lug. Inside shelves hold neatly banded BANKNOTE BUNDLES. Adult gray-suited bank manager and two navy officers inspect shelves, one counts bundles with paper inventory. Drawer OPEN in nearby workbench contains additional banknote bundles, cold cutting torch on bench. Clearly same vault geography as ref2, no tank now, no villains or heroes except Billy. Warm sunset through tall factory windows. NO headlines/signs or legible printed text. Do not show building shrunk, no magic beam, no fire or modern laptop. Billy remains plainly older not boy.
images.reviewNotes: Older Billy, open left-hinged freestanding vault with plasma damage, bank manager, police inventory, vault money and separate drawer bundles. No villains or tank added.

Do not change anyone else's age, face, pose or outfit. One full LANDSCAPE 3:2 scene, no text/panels/duplicate glove.
